mods.name: Simple Location Marking
mods.description: A lightweight, client-side location marking (waypoint) mod inspired by the Waypoints feature of Xaero's Minimap. Mark places with a colored hexagon palette, manage them per world, server and dimension with the P key, and see clean 3D markers with distances in-game. No minimap and no teleportation.
